card.$description: Raised from 235 so cards separate from the background (1.29:1)

muted.$description: Tonal buttons and the stepper on cards; one step above the card

mutedForegroundOnTile.$description: Secondary text and chevrons on a row card on an accent tile: Muted foreground in light; Stone 880 in dark, 5.5:1 or more on every cardOnTile (Stone 840 was 4.7:1, Stone 740 3.35:1)

primary.$description: Buttons, the send button, the shopper's bubbles

tint.$description: Selected tab, links, icons that act

chipSelected.$description: Tonal Indigo selection on controls other than filter chips: the current order step, Android segmented control and snackbar action, the debugger

chipSelectedRaised.$description: A selected filter chip on a sheet, a Card section or the shop page card in dark: Indigo 850, 1.5:1 from the sheet, with onChipSelected text (tags.md)

chipSelectedOnTile.$description: A selected filter chip on a shop's accent tile in dark (the Category screen): Indigo 950, 1.4 to 1.5:1 from the tiles (tags.md)

fill.$description: An unselected chip and the Needs you pill on the Background or a chat in dark: Stone 320, 1.55:1 from the Background, no edge (tags.md)

fillRaised.$description: The same on a sheet, a Card section or the shop page card in dark: Stone 360, 1.58:1 from the sheet and 1.41:1 from Card (tags.md)

chipSelectedEdge.$description: A 1 pt edge on a selected chip, so its tonal fill holds its own next to Card chips (colour.md, Roles)

filterSelected.$description: Selected filter chip: Foreground fill, so Indigo means action, not selection (tags.md)

mapGround.$description: Map ground: the dark Background, so the card (Sheet) separates from it

mapRoad.$description: Minor roads and streets on the map

mapBuilding.$description: Buildings on the map, lit from one side by the extrusion light

mapPark.$description: Parks on the map: low-chroma Pistachio

mapWater.$description: Water on the map: low-chroma cool

photoScrim.$description: Shop photo carousel: black, faded from state.photoScrim at the bottom edge of each photo to nothing, so the white dots hold their contrast on a pale photo (round 10; the Background scrim left a pale photo pale)

lightbox.$description: Photo viewer ground: black in both schemes, as Photos and Airbnb do, so a photo is the brightest thing on the screen

onLightbox.$description: Count and controls on the photo viewer: 21:1 on Lightbox

onLightboxMuted.$description: Hint under the photo on the viewer: white at 75% on Lightbox, 11.4:1

success.$description: Check icon on Ready, Paid and Collected (colour.md)

successOnTile.$description: The Open word on an accent tile (the shop page's status line, the Category rows): Foreground in dark, because Success is 4.5:1 or less on the tinted row cards

warningOnTile.$description: The Closes soon word on an accent tile: Warning 800 in light (700 is 4.30:1 on Peach), Foreground in dark

border.$description: A card on a busy area, text fields

separator.$description: 1 px lines between rows, inset to the text

codeSurface.$description: QR code background: white in both modes (components.md, Collection code)

wash.$description: The light stripes of the awning band on the placeholder tile

tile.$description: Placeholder tile, category card, the shop page header, the receipt header

ink.$description: Initials and the dark awning stripes on the tile

cardOnTile.$description: Rows on this accent's tile (the Category screen): a tinted card lighter than the tile, so rows don't read as holes (decision 050)

detail.$description: Small accents on the neutral shop page: the band on the card, the chips and the map pin. Pastel in both modes: small areas in the light tone are fine on dark (Material dark theme)

ground.$description: A chat's ground is the app's Background in both modes (colour.md, Snuffle)

fill.$description: Chips and grouped rows on the chat ground: Card white in light, Card in dark

edge.$description: Hairline around cards and grouped rows on the chat ground

field.$description: The composer field in every place it appears (New Request, a chat, Requests): Card with a Border hairline, in both modes

fieldEdge.$description: Hairline around the composer field and the chips on a chat

sheet.$description: Sheet ground, one Stone step above the Background (L 0.22, 1.16:1 on the Background); rows inside a sheet take Muted (1.33:1) (shape.md, Sheets)

askEdge.$description: 1 pt edge of the Nearby ask bar and the Requests circle, at state.askEdge

count.$description: The count on the Requests button: Indigo 800 in light, Indigo 300 in dark (Indigo 800 on the dark Background is 2.24:1)

glassEdge.$description: Web glass: the 0.5 pt hairline and the drop shadow colour

glassShine.$description: Web glass: the 0.5 pt inner highlight along the top edge

shadow.$description: Colour of the delicate card shadow

location.$description: The location ask in dark mode: Stone 360, the ground the quiet street is rendered for and the colour of the soft radial lift behind it (outlines 1.67:1 at its centre, mid-tones 1.5 to 4.7:1). The screen itself is the Background, so text keeps its usual contrast; colour.md, Location ask

welcome.$description: Getting started in dark mode: Indigo 900, then the Peach and Pistachio dark tiles, under the same Foreground

ground1.$description: Page 1: Indigo 800, the splash's own ground in both modes, so the hand-off from the splash doesn't jump to another Indigo; text 8.75:1

ground3.$description: Page 3, a deeper green than the Pistachio dark tile, which read as olive on a full screen; text 11.5:1

tonalOnTile.$description: Tonal buttons on a shop's accent tile (the shop page's actions), at state.tonalOnTile (colour.md, Shop accents)

chipOn.$description: A selected filter chip's text and edge, on a Card fill: Indigo 800 in light, Indigo 300 in dark (tags.md)

sheetScrim.$description: Black at state.sheetScrim behind every sheet (shape.md, Sheets)

track.$description: iOS segmented control track: Border in light, Card in dark (components.md, Segmented control)

thumb.$description: iOS segmented control thumb, a step above the Card track (1.37:1 on it; Muted was 1.15:1 and the thumb all but vanished), under the delicate shadow

glassHairline.$description: Web glass: the 0.5 pt hairline, Stone 360 in full, so glass reads on the dark Background (shape.md, Glass recipe)

grabber.$description: The sheet's grabber: Muted foreground at state.grabber in light; Stone 445 in full in dark (2.37:1, solid; Muted foreground at 38% rendered #514F4C, 2.19:1)

splash.$description: The splash and its intro (motion.md, Splash): Indigo 800, the brand colour, in both modes, with the mark in white and Indigo 300 (mark.md)

ground.$description: Splash ground, also the native splash colour; white on it 8.75:1

ink.$description: The mark's face and three stripes on the splash

soft.$description: The mark's two lighter stripes on the splash; 4.94:1 on the ground, 1.8:1 beside white

photoScrim.$description: Opacity of color.photoScrim (black) at the bottom edge of a shop photo

photoPill.$description: Opacity of the black pill the carousel's dots sit in, over the scrim: 20% (round 12; the critique asked for about 12%, which measured 2.5 to 2.8:1 for the white dots on a pale photo; 30% read as a dark lozenge)

tonalOnTile.$description: Dark: white at 6% over the tile, 1.19 to 1.20:1 on it (Muted was 1.08 to 1.20:1 and read as a dirty patch)

sheetScrim.$description: Opacity of color.sheetScrim behind a sheet at rest (shape.md, Sheets)

askEdge.$description: Opacity of color.askEdge: white at 10% in dark

grabber.$description: Opacity of color.grabber: 38% in light, full in dark

glassSaturateOnTile.$description: Web glass on a tile: backdrop saturation, 1 in dark (1.6 turned Peach and Pistachio into the loudest thing on the screen)

glassShadowOnTile.$description: Web glass on a tile: no drop shadow in dark (it read as a halo)
